[[Master Togo]] tells you to speak with [[Headmaster Quin]] in [[Shing Jea Monastery]] to begin your [[ritualist]] training.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = factions
}}
* No secondary profession
* Primary profession not a [[Ritualist]]

===Objectives===
* Speak with Headmaster Quin in the Shing Jea Monastery

===Reward===
* 50 [[Experience]]

==Walkthrough==
Go to southeastern [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. The headmasters are gathered in one place.

==Dialogue==
===Initial dialogue===
;Master Togo
''If you are interested in taking the Ritualist profession as your secondary field of study, then you will need to speak with [[Headmaster Quin]].''

''Quin is an old friend of mine. She can be a bit pompous at times, but she is an accomplished Ritualist and a great teacher. You will learn much from her. Seek her out in the [[Shing Jea Monastery]].''
{{ Offer dialog
| accept = I will seek out Headmaster Quin.
| decline = I'm not sure about this.
| ask = If you wish to become a Ritualist, find [[Headmaster Quin]] in the [[Shing Jea Monastery|monastery]]. In any case, you must leave me to my work now.
}}

===Reward dialogue===
;Headmaster Quin
''I am never surprised when a student chooses to become a Ritualist. Our profession is superior to all others. If you are ready to train with me, I will teach you to create wonderful things out of nothing at all. But do not waste my time or yours: consider your decision carefully.''
